prefs.title: Dietary preferences
prefs.intro: These are personal: other people in your household can't change them. They'll help us suggest recipes.
prefs.disclaimer: Recipe tags are written by users and don't guarantee that allergens are absent. Always check the ingredients.

installGuide.title: Install QuéComo
installGuide.intro: Install QuéComo on your home screen to open it like an app, even offline.
installGuide.installed: QuéComo is already installed on this device.

ios.title: iPhone or iPad
steps: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up).
Choose “Add to Home Screen” and confirm.
Open QuéComo from its new icon.

android.title: Android
steps: Tap “Install” if prompted, or open the ⋮ menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

desktop.title: Computer
steps: Open QuéComo in Chrome or Edge.
Click the install icon in the address bar, or use the browser menu and choose “Install QuéComo”.
In Safari on Mac: File menu → “Add to Dock”.

privacyPage.title: Privacy and data
privacyPage.body1: Your recipes, menus and lists are stored on our server (Supabase, in the European Union) and are only visible to the people in each household.
privacyPage.body2: QuéComo has no advertising or third-party analytics.
privacyPage.body3: To download a copy of your data or delete your account, contact the QuéComo administrator. You'll soon be able to do it from here.
